appupd.title: Tool update
appupd.lead: Besides at startup, you can check for and install a new version here.
appupd.warn.auto: The tool will restart after the update finishes
appupd.warn.manual: You will need to restart the tool after the update finishes
appupd.done.manual: Please close the tool and start it again.
appupd.restart.timeout: Could not confirm the restart. Please close the tool and start it again from start_wfportal.bat.
appupd.apply.failed: The update failed. You can keep using the current version. Please try again later.
appupd.state.older: You are using a newer version (v{current}) than the published one (v{remote}).
appupd.state.off: Updates are turned off for this folder (NO_AUTO_UPDATE file or WFPORTAL_NO_UPDATE).
appupd.state.git: This folder is managed by git, so it is not updated here (use git pull).
appupd.state.broken: version.json cannot be read, so updates cannot be checked.
appupd.state.failed: Could not check for the latest version. Check your internet connection and try again later.
